newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH AIR TOUR OPERATORS ANNOUNCE FUEL SURCHARGE.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH AIR TOUR OPERATORS ANNOUNCE FUEL SURCHARGE.

text.p: Dutch air tour operators' association ANVR said on Tuesday it was introducing a fuel surcharge on summer charter bookings from April 1 to October 31.

"Trends in fuel and dollar prices...for the coming season have led to the conclusion that surcharges...roughly comparable to those currently in force during the winter season will also have to be levied in the summer season," ANVR said.
It said the levies had been agreed in consultation with the Dutch charter airlines -- Transavia, Martinair and Air Holland.

The fuel surcharge -- ranging from 20 guilders for European destinations such as Spain, Portugal and Britain to 46 guilders for destinations in the Caribbean region and Mexico -- will also be levied on holidays which have already been booked, ANVR said.
